result.reviewScopeSummary: Initial verification covered Story 2 AC/TC requirements, Flow 2 tech design, production capture/idempotency/failure paths, Story 2 tests, configured gates, and targeted manual reproductions for reload redelivery, health surfacing, and unsupported content handling.

newFindings.title: Reload/crash-replay redelivery records duplicates instead of skipping them
newFindings.evidence: AC-2.6 and TC-2.7 require redelivered reload/replay events to be skipped by the same idempotency key. The production connector seeds captureSession.sourceSeq from inspect.overview event count on session_start (packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:312-326), then generates new entry ids from that counter for message/runtime hooks (packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:364-378). TurnAccumulator likewise seeds turn_end keys from closed turn count (packages/pi-lhc/src/capture/turn-accumulator.ts:35-62). Because eventKey gives entryId first precedence (packages/pi-lhc/src/capture/idempotency.ts:38-44), a redelivered historical message after reload gets a new key instead of the original key. Manual reproduction against built production code: after recording user_prompt 'first' and turn_end, a reload redelivering the same user message produced four stored events [user_prompt, turn_end, user_prompt, turn_end] with keys s0/turn:0 and s2/turn:1; connector diagnostic was null. Existing reattach tests prove new post-resume messages record, but do not prove reload/crash-replay historical redelivery skips.

newFindings.title: Writable capture gaps are not surfaced in thread health
newFindings.evidence: AC-2.7 and TC-2.8 require a malformed/unmappable event on a writable thread to record a durable, queryable gap that surfaces in thread health. capture() records the gap as a runtime_note (packages/pi-lhc/src/capture/converter.ts:48-56) and connector state records lastCaptureFailure (packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:344-358), but inspect health is composed only from message/turn form reports (packages/lhc/src/domains/inspect/internal/health.ts:40-108). The current test asserts only listEvents contains a runtime_note (packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/converter.test.ts:149-158), not inspect.health. Manual reproduction after capture([malformed turn_end]) showed the runtime_note gap in listEvents, while inspect.health returned owners=[], failures=[], repairPreview=[], queue={queued:0,claimed:0}.

newFindings.title: Unsupported tool-result content parts are silently omitted
newFindings.evidence: The story risk reminders and tech design require unsupported image/file-reference parts to record an omission rather than vanish silently. map-message.ts defines unsupportedOf/omissionText and uses them for user and assistant messages (packages/pi-lhc/src/capture/map-message.ts:52-61, 131-168), but mapToolResult only joins text parts and emits one tool_result (packages/pi-lhc/src/capture/map-message.ts:185-197). Manual mapMessage({role:'toolResult', toolCallId:'call_file', content:[{type:'fileRef', path:'/tmp/out.png'}]}) returned only tool_result with content:'' and no runtime_note omission.

verified: AC-2.1 / TC-2.1 happy-path user, assistant, and toolResult capture in source order with assistant thinking -> text -> tool_call fan-out.
AC-2.2 / TC-2.2 / TC-2.3 PI per-step turn_end is ignored, LHC turn_end is emitted at agent_end, and repeated turnIndex values do not drive ordering.
AC-2.3 / TC-2.4 parallel tool results carry toolCallId and preserve out-of-order arrival without arrival-order correlation.
AC-2.4 / TC-2.5 error tool result captures content with isError true.
AC-2.5 / TC-2.6 graceful interrupt captures partial assistant content, carries aborted disposition, and closes the turn at agent_end.
AC-2.8 / TC-2.9 model_select and thinking_level_select are captured as ordered runtime_note events with previous and new values.
Direct same-key capture() batch reflush dedups through LHC intakeStream and returns skipped duplicate_idempotency_key outcomes.
Story gate pnpm --filter pi-lhc verify passed.
Epic gate pnpm --filter pi-lhc verify-all passed.
unverified: AC-2.6 / TC-2.7 production hook-level reload and crash-replay redelivery: manual reproduction shows duplicates, not skips.
AC-2.7 / TC-2.8 thread-health surfacing for durable writable capture gaps: manual reproduction shows inspect.health does not report the gap.
TechDesign-I-6 unsupported image/file-reference omission coverage for toolResult messages: code audit and manual mapper call show omission is not recorded.

productionPathFindings: Production connector idempotency currently uses attach-time event/turn counts as the generated entry-id seed; that fixes normal resume append collisions but breaks reload/crash-replay redelivery dedup by assigning historical events new keys.
Writable-thread capture failure is persisted as a runtime_note but is not represented in LHC inspect.health, so the durable gap is queryable only as a generic event log entry, not as thread health.
mapToolResult silently drops non-text fileRef/image parts because unsupported-part omission handling is only implemented for user and assistant messages.
No material fake/mock intake path was found in Story 2 capture execution; production capture writes through real LHC intakeStream.messageEvents. Test fakes are confined to fixtures/config.
additionalObservations: Configured gates pass with 58 tests, but the required reload/crash-replay and health-surfacing scenarios are not covered by those tests.
